title: 1D Gaussian Stationary Hold & Target Shift Recovery
intuition: Continues the candidate's own passing `gaussian1d_smoke` checkpoint to test the Law 4.4 settling-versus-tracking dilemma: first hold N(2, 0.5^2) stably across stationary updates, then rapidly re-acquire a shifted target within deadline and hold it.
failure_mode: Recipes with aggressive LR annealing freeze and miss the shifted target, whereas recipes without settling damping oscillate around the stationary bell curve and fail hold checks.
protocol_notes: Strict checkpoint continuation from `gaussian1d_smoke`; cannot pass without a valid passing smoke parent.
